_meta.description: Labeled benchmark for ambiguity detection. Each item has expected_hitl=true when the pipeline SHOULD ask the user for clarification, and expected_hitl=false when the pipeline should confidently answer.

questions.question: How many employees are in the company?
List all departments and their budgets.
What is the average salary of all employees?
Show the five employees with the highest salaries.
How many customers are in California?
List every product whose price is greater than 100.
How many completed sales happened in 2024?
For each department, how many employees work in it?
What is the total revenue from all completed sales?
Which customer has placed the most completed orders?
questions.rationale: JOIN sales + customers GROUP BY customer ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1.

questions.question: List all products that currently have zero inventory anywhere.
Show each employee along with the name of the department they belong to.
How many active projects exist?
List the top 3 products by total quantity sold in completed sales.
Show every warehouse's name and city.
What is the most expensive product by price?
How many employees were hired in 2023?
What is the total budget across all departments?
List each category name and the number of products in it.
questions.rationale: LEFT JOIN categories + products, GROUP BY.

questions.question: Show each employee's first name, last name, and their manager's full name.
Who earns the most?
questions.rationale: 'Earns' could mean salary (employees), or revenue generated (sales). Also unclear if looking for person or role.

questions.question: What is the total?
questions.rationale: Total of what? Revenue, employees, budget, inventory?

questions.question: Show the top customers.
questions.rationale: Top by what? Count, revenue, recency, credit limit?

questions.question: How are we performing?
questions.rationale: No metric, no time window, no entity.

questions.question: Give me the best product.
questions.rationale: Best by units sold, revenue, margin, rating?

questions.question: Show recent activity.
questions.rationale: Which activity? Sales, assignments, hires? What counts as recent?

questions.question: List the big departments.
questions.rationale: Big by headcount, budget, number of projects?

questions.question: How much did we spend last quarter?
questions.rationale: Spend is not a modeled concept — departments have budgets, projects have budgets, employees have salaries, products have cost.

questions.question: Find the manager.
questions.rationale: Which manager? Any specific manager? Top-of-chain? By department?

questions.question: What's underperforming?
questions.rationale: No entity, no metric, no threshold.

questions.question: Show me the most important customer.
questions.rationale: Importance can mean revenue, volume, recency, credit limit.

questions.question: Show employee productivity.
questions.rationale: Productivity is not a column; could mean sales count, revenue per employee, hours allocated.

questions.question: What are the trends?
questions.rationale: Trends of what, over what timeframe?

questions.question: How expensive is the company?
questions.rationale: Total salaries? Total budgets? Total product cost? Market valuation (not in DB)?

questions.question: Give me the summary.
Who are the leaders?
Show good customers.
questions.rationale: Good by spend, by frequency, by credit limit, by recency?

questions.question: Which products are low?
questions.rationale: Low on inventory, low price, low sales?

questions.question: How much revenue did sales make?
questions.rationale: No time window. Could be ever, this year, last month. Borderline-ambiguous but likely needs clarification if pipeline is strict.

questions.question: Show me the best people.
questions.rationale: Best at what? Sales? Tenure? Not defined.

questions.question: List all employees and their hire dates.
How many projects are active?
For each project, how many employees are assigned to it?
Which department has the largest budget?
List employees hired after 2020-01-01.
Count the total number of project assignments.
Show each project's name along with its department name.
What is the budget?
questions.rationale: Department budget? Project budget? Which one?

questions.question: Show me the best employees.
questions.rationale: Best by tenure? Project count? Not defined in schema.

questions.question: Tell me about engineering.
questions.rationale: Which aspect? Budget, headcount, projects, employees?

questions.question: List the heavy projects.
questions.rationale: Heavy by hours allocated, budget, team size?

questions.question: Show project costs.
questions.rationale: Cost could mean project.budget, or SUM(hours_allocated) from assignments.

questions.question: Who is busy?
questions.rationale: Busy = most assignments? Most hours? Multiple projects?

questions.question: What's the workload?
questions.rationale: Per employee? Per project? Per department?

questions.question: How many SEC submissions are in the database?
List all distinct form types in the submissions table.
How many filings were made in fiscal year 2022?
What are the five most common SIC codes in submissions?
questions.rationale: GROUP BY sic ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5.

questions.question: How many companies filed form 10-K?
List all tags where the datatype is monetary.
How many numbers are associated with adsh = '0001193125-22-017125'?
Show me the biggest filings.
questions.rationale: Biggest by numbers count, by filed date, by company size (not in DB)?

questions.question: Which company has the best numbers?
questions.rationale: Best by which financial tag? Numbers table has many values per filing.

questions.question: Show me significant events.
Give me a summary of submissions.
questions.rationale: What shape of summary? By year, form, sic, country?

questions.question: What are the key metrics?
questions.rationale: 'Key' metrics undefined; numbers table has thousands of tags.

questions.question: Which tags are important?
